reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.

reviewed.findings: Literal UUID/string oracles are independent; no cross-semantic-type or malformed durable-record assertion in this module. The version=length tuple is awkward but correct.
reviewed.consumer: Public Identity used through imports; companion invariant module covers inherited validation.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Parametrized UUID constructor regressions on base and inherited specialization

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Aware UTC normalization, ISO conversion, arithmetic and negative difference refusal

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Five unit factories, stored timedelta invariant, accessors and arithmetic protocol
reviewed.findings: P2 existing ea7c18ff reproduced in all six original cases: negative inputs round to zero before validation. Stored values never become negative. Two negative-scaling edge cases require separate compatibility qualification.
reviewed.consumer: Stopwatch precision and Commands timeout use the rounded value; accepted local Qwen candidate was not production adoption.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Monotonic perf_counter_ns measurement, running/stopped state, idempotent stop and context exit
reviewed.findings: Correct under documented monotonic, process-local clock. Microsecond storage rounds 100ns to zero. No deadline/reset/restart/thread-safety/distributed-clock contract.
reviewed.consumer: CommandExecutor and WorkCycle directly instantiate and stop it; measured elapsed is not a source of grant authority.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Timestamp dispatch, normalization, ordered ISO/alternate datetime/date formats and typed parsing failure
reviewed.findings: Existing Timestamp passes through; naive/date explicitly mean UTC; ISO parser breadth is delegated to stdlib. Unsupported runtime types remain outside annotated API.
reviewed.consumer: Representation conversion is not authentication of external time; durable JSON/SQLite and usage use stricter per-owner schemas around Timestamp.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Nine Timestamp/Duration public-value tests, arithmetic failures and positive nanosecond precision
reviewed.findings: Positive factory checks and normal negative values are covered; tiny negative raw inputs, negative scaling to zero, nonfinite inputs, DST folds and extremes are absent.
reviewed.consumer: Focused execution passes; independent literal probes expose the missing input-sign boundary.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Timestamp pass-through, date/aware/naive parsing, nine literal formats, four invalid strings, ISO-only and error hierarchy
reviewed.findings: Literal UTC datetime oracles are meaningful. now(None) checks UTC shape only, not delegation timing. DST folds, boundaries and serialization consumers require additional evidence.
reviewed.consumer: Public parser/error exports used; independent DST/round-trip/native-overflow probes supplement tests.

reviewed.scope: Full body, independent tests and actual lifecycle consumer; no review credit assigned by selection.
reviewed.role: Three injected-clock stopwatch tests, state/idempotence and exception propagation
reviewed.findings: Deterministic monkeypatch is appropriate. Expected elapsed uses Duration.nanoseconds itself; 100ns checks normalize to zero and do not independently check numeric conversion.
reviewed.consumer: Independent 100us/400us literal checks establish observed conversion and exact call count; no need for a clock framework.
